analysis.title: Monochrome Instrument Panel Landing Page
analysis.notes: A near-black landing page uses a large cropped laptop mockup as the dominant visual, with a compact timer interface centered inside it. Thin light typography, muted utility labels, and small blue controls create a precise, instrument-like atmosphere.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a minimalist dark product-landing-page hero on a deep black background with generous negative space. Show a large cropped matte-black laptop emerging from the lower half, its screen displaying a compact rounded black timer panel with a white dot-matrix countdown, tiny gray controls, and one restrained electric-blue active state. Use delicate off-white grotesk typography, sparse utility icons, subtle screen reflections, and soft edge lighting. Center the interface and maintain a calm, highly precise, editorial composition. No readable brand names, logos, or recognizable software identities.
